hub.title: Welcome to Kinemo
hub.subtitle: Select a module to manage your 4D cinema operations.

catalog.title: Movie Catalog
catalog.description: Register 4D movies, associate effects files, and manage the catalog available for scheduling.

sensory.title: Sensory Content
sensory.description: Upload and validate sensory tracks, assign intensity levels, and manage configuration history.

scheduling.title: Scheduling
scheduling.description: Program 4D shows, manage room availability, and block time slots for maintenance.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: View occupancy, resource consumption, and per-room performance metrics.

ticketing.title: Ticketing Integration
ticketing.description: Monitor the connection to your external ticketing system and review synced occupancy data.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.description: Manage your Kinemo plan, payment methods, screen limits, and renewals.

room-readiness.title: Room Readiness
room-readiness.description: Verify room status, calculate water and air requirements, and log inspections before each show.

seat-control.title: Seat Allocation
seat-control.description: View the seat map, activate sold seats, and block individual seats for service.

execution.title: 4D Execution
execution.description: Start, pause, and conclude effect sequences; monitor synchronization and hardware state.

emergency.title: Emergency Management
emergency.description: Trigger emergency stops, block execution, and log restoration with confirmation.

testing.title: Testing & Calibration
testing.description: Test effect channels, adjust intensity, and level seats before opening the room.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Report incidents, schedule preventive maintenance, and track component lifecycle.

about.title: About Kinemo
about.mission: Kinemo democratizes access to immersive cinematic experiences, enabling cinema chains of any size to offer their audiences physical sensations synchronized with the content.
about.approach: We combine affordable haptic hardware, specialized maintenance, and our own management software under a service model that removes the capital barrier that large chains impose on smaller operators.
about.startup-content: We are a software engineering team from Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas, building Kinemo as a solution to close the gap between large cinema chains with proprietary 4D technology and the small and medium chains that cannot compete on experience.
